events.text_en: Nghê Hồng Đậu plants the first red-bean trellis over the vein at Tiêu Âm Mạch, five tiles inland from her gracious door.
Hàn Tư Quân, first disciple of Hồng Đậu Trang, tries to carry Phi Hồng to Lạc Hà. The mistress meets him at the door with a cup of tea. He is buried under the first trellis.
The mistress of Hồng Đậu Trang moves her rooms from the manor on the forest road to the vein garden, where no bell line reaches. The house on the road keeps the gracious door.
A Phượng Minh swordsman knocks at the gracious door, asks about the Tower's poisons, and is poured a second cup. He does not go home.
